scope: Independent native Linux KVM UAPI timer controls; not RAX producer or full CPU-state restoration

assumptions.assumption: Native output completion precedes the settled capture
assumptions.basis: KVM_RUN with immediate_exit settles the output and returns EINTR
assumptions.stress_test: Distinguish the output instruction from a newly delivered timer interrupt
assumptions.falsification_probe: Saved RIP differs from 0x2004 or source does not return to 0x1002 after EOI/IRET
assumptions.status: confirmed in all five settled controls

assumptions.assumption: The real-mode fixture can issue EOI to LAPIC MMIO
assumptions.basis: Expanded DS limit in the independently initialized native graph
assumptions.stress_test: Default 64 KiB DS would fault at the MMIO address
assumptions.falsification_probe: Source ISR remains set or post-handler RIP is not 0x1002
assumptions.status: confirmed in all five settled controls

assumptions.assumption: Exported LAPIC register bytes distinguish expired-pending from delivered-completed one-shot phase
assumptions.dependent_result: Sufficiency of a raw LAPIC bank
assumptions.stress_test: Compare all 1024 exported bytes before delivery and after EOI
assumptions.falsification_probe: Identical records with opposite delivery requirements
assumptions.status: falsified in four of five settled controls

bounded_scope.item: Complete producer must conserve one-shot pending/completed phase; ordinary GET/SET bank replay duplicates delivery in these controls
bounded_scope.blocks: C-STATE and native checkpoint continuation under C-SMP

bounded_scope.item: PIT phase/reinjection, periodic/deadline timers and actual first-entry activation remain unqualified by these controls
Linux v6.8 and QEMU v9.2.0 source are explanatory primary references, not proof that another runtime or kernel version reproduces this behavior

unrun: Active periodic and TSC-deadline timer migration

quality_gates.native_builds_and_runs: both controls built with -Wall -Wextra -Werror and executed five times
